assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.quote: The incidence of radial nerve palsy in the United States (US) is approximately 2.9 cases per 100,000 persons per year.

assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.quote: In the United Kingdom, the annual incidence of radial neuropathy is estimated at 2.97 per 100,000 in men

assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.quote: The mean age at presentation is 38

assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.quote: with men affected about twice as often as women

assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.quote: A recent meta-analysis reported radial nerve palsy in approximately 12.2% of patients with humeral shaft fractures

assertions.subject: Radial neuropathy
assertions.predicate: association with humeral shaft fractures in pediatric populations
assertions.quote: The incidence is lower in pediatric populations, with radial nerve palsy occurring in approximately 4.3% of children with humeral shaft fractures

assertions.subject: Mononeuritis multiplex
assertions.quote: Connective tissue diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, may manifest as wrist drop within mononeuritis multiplex

assertions.subject: Focal neuropathies
assertions.quote: Nutritional deficiencies, including thiamine deficiency, may rarely induce focal neuropathies in chronic alcoholism or malnutrition

assertions.subject: Radial nerve dysfunction
assertions.quote: Heavy metal toxicity, particularly lead poisoning, remains a relevant global cause of radial nerve dysfunction
